restart_current_replicas.classification: stale n-2 current copy relative to e2

reconstruction_rule: Before consulting intents, reject any current candidate lacking its completed self-certificate or whose immutable predecessor link cannot be validated.
Among valid current candidates, order by predecessor reachability rather than numeric generation. Select only a unique maximal candidate whose lower valid candidates are ancestors on the same chain.
If two valid candidates are incomparable forks, fail closed before reading intents.

Only after one predecessor epoch is selected, inspect intents bound exactly to that epoch; deduplicate by effect_id plus payload_hash and repair a missing replica only by copying the same bound intent record.
A successor becomes an admissible current candidate only after the chosen intent has produced the successor and the successor current record has been self-certified.

rejected_current_candidates.reason: missing completed self-certificate despite larger numeric generation

result.why_unique: e0 is an ancestor of e2 and no other certified incomparable head exists
result.intent_selection: i3 is admissible because it is bound exactly to selected predecessor e2 and no conflicting effect_id/payload_hash pair is present
result.one_copy_intent_repair: safe within tested scope: copy the identical e2-bound i3 record to the missing replica before successor materialization
result.numeric_generation_baseline: fails the probe because max(generation) would select partial e3 before certification and could expose an uncommitted successor as current
result.predecessor_linked_epoch_chain: passes the modeled restart by selecting e2 and delaying intent consultation until after predecessor identity is fixed

negative_control.fork_case: If two certified heads e2a and e2b both descend from e1 and neither reaches the other, the rule returns no predecessor and fails closed before consulting either branch's intents.
negative_control.scope: reasoned control only; no concurrent repository writers were executed

mechanism_revision: Use a non-reused predecessor epoch identity plus completed successor self-certification as the restart root of trust. Numeric generation is metadata only; it cannot authorize a candidate. Intents are causally downstream of unique predecessor selection, and missing intent replicas may be repaired only after that selection.

assessment.repository_transport_role: lightweight role-local state/evidence persistence and readback only
assessment.accepted_scope: three-transition symbolic restart with one uncertified newest current copy, one stale ancestor current copy, one certified latest predecessor, and one missing duplicate intent replica
not_proven: two conflicting intents bound to the same predecessor

conflict_check: Semantic inputs were limited to frozen sanitized controls and own neuroscience LATEST/preflight. No O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger, other-role receipt/config, scheduler, protected-primary, hosted-compute, paid, finite-credit, or manual-user execution semantics were used.
exact_next_action: Next valid invocation: checkpoint first, then execute exactly one symbolic crash-window probe with two competing intents bound to the same certified predecessor e2. Compare intent-before-current and current-before-intent interruption points. Test whether deterministic effect_id/payload_hash conflict detection plus predecessor binding can force fail-closed or idempotent replay without global CAS, and preserve a concrete alternative if same-predecessor conflicting intents remain ambiguous.
